subject: Judge: review dashboard backend selector + AV-awareness message
description: Single-attempt code review (self-learn-judge review mode) of the dashboard-selector attempt. get_attempt_diff, then rubric: (1) selector fetches GET /config/backend + renders per-provider isAvailable/isAuthed status + active highlight; save POSTs /config/backend correctly; (2) the local-CLI AV-awareness notice renders when an agentic-cli backend (Claude/Codex/Cursor) is selected/active and NOT for api-kind — verify the message accurately describes the hidden-process/AV interception issue and points to AV-exclusion OR the API backend (this is the explicit user requirement); (3) consistent with existing dashboard serving/styling, no broken assets; (4) scope = dashboard + AV message only, no provider/api-impl leakage; tests/verification present. Under the feature, APPROVE → merge_attempt (attempt→feature, auto-abort on conflict); KICK BACK → set_status failed + record_decision wired to the impl. NEVER force-merge.
